name: B10-0079/2026 (PfE) – Presidential elections in Honduras, the non-recognition of the outcome by the incumbent administration and the attacks on opposition members of the National Assembly
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the presidential elections in Honduras, the non-recognition of the outcome by the incumbent administration and the attacks on opposition members of the National Assembly
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Honduras to respect the result of its presidential election, which it says was won by Nasry Asfura of the Partido Nacional and confirmed by the country's electoral authority. It condemns political violence, including an attack on a member of the Honduran Congress, and asks for those responsible to be investigated and prosecuted. It also urges the European Union and its member states to work closely with the new Honduran government on the economy, security, organised crime and illegal migration. The text states positions and requests; it does not change any law.

- The Parliament backs Asfura's confirmed election win and rejects calls to annul the vote.
- It condemns political violence in Honduras and asks for the Congress attack to be prosecuted.
- It urges the European Union and member states to cooperate with Asfura's new government.
